limitations: Other host activity and CPU scheduling/frequency were not controlled; load and swap deltas are retained per sample. No specific environmental cause was established.
Three samples per version/configuration are insufficient to overcome the observed variation.
Each one-source profile uses one thread, including requested process execution; this does not measure multi-source process behavior.
RSS sampling includes API execution and bounded post-API equality checks; aggregate RSS is a sum rather than unique physical memory.
Cross-configuration default medians would additionally compare different time blocks and are not used as new acceptance evidence.
method: Three sequential alternating fresh-process pairs per configuration, with unchanged dependencies, input bytes, all-market selection, four requested workers and native CSV settings. No tests or other benchmark configurations were run concurrently by this campaign.

profiling.discarded_initial_profile: Concurrent sampler/event-loop activity made the first exploratory profiles unsuitable for isolated phase attribution; direct synchronous profiles supersede them.
profiling.finding: Canonical scalar field conversion and the independent scalar preflight digest dominate preflight cost; canonical field conversion dominates worker cost.
profiling.scope: Separate synchronous cProfile runs of preflight and worker. Instrumented times are not pipeline speedups.
